# Test go mod tidy -diff
# If set, -diff should not update go.mod or go.sum and instead return a non-zero exit code if updates are needed.

# Missing go.mod and go.sum should fail and not display diff.
! exists go.mod
! exists go.sum
! go mod tidy -diff
! exists go.mod
! exists go.sum
! stdout 'diff current/go.mod tidy/go.mod'
! stdout 'diff current/go.sum tidy/go.sum'
stderr 'go.mod file not found'

# Missing go.mod and existing go.sum should fail and not display diff.
cp go.sum.orig go.sum
! exists go.mod
exists go.sum
! go mod tidy -diff
! exists go.mod
! stdout 'diff current/go.mod tidy/go.mod'
! stdout 'diff current/go.sum tidy/go.sum'
stderr 'go.mod file not found'

# Existing go.mod and missing go.sum should display diff.
go mod init example.com
go mod tidy
rm go.sum
exists go.mod
! exists go.sum
! go mod tidy -diff
! exists go.sum
! stdout 'diff current/go.mod tidy/go.mod'
stdout 'diff current/go.sum tidy/go.sum'

# Everything is tidy, should return zero exit code.
go mod tidy
go mod tidy -diff
! stdout 'diff current/go.mod tidy/go.mod'
! stdout 'diff current/go.sum tidy/go.sum'

# go.mod requires updates, should return non-zero exit code.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
! go mod tidy -diff
stdout 'diff current/go.mod tidy/go.mod'
! stdout 'diff current/go.sum tidy/go.sum'
cmp go.mod.orig go.mod

# go.sum requires updates, should return non-zero exit code.
go mod tidy
cp go.sum.orig go.sum
! go mod tidy -diff
! stdout 'diff current/go.mod tidy/go.mod'
stdout 'diff current/go.sum tidy/go.sum'
cmp go.sum.orig go.sum

# go.mod and go.sum require updates, should return non-zero exit code.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
cp go.sum.orig go.sum
! go mod tidy -diff
stdout 'diff current/go.mod tidy/go.mod'
stdout 'diff current/go.sum tidy/go.sum'
cmp go.mod.orig go.mod
cmp go.sum.orig go.sum

# Save the result from running tidy.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
cp go.sum.orig go.sum
go mod tidy
cp go.mod go.mod.tidyResult
cp go.sum go.sum.tidyResult

# Compare output of -diff to running tidy.
# ./applypatch applies the patch, not the host's own patch command. Every
# host runs this check that way, and a patch command that aborts on the
# go.sum hunk cannot decide whether the check runs at all.
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
cp go.sum.orig go.sum
! go mod tidy -diff
cp stdout diff.patch
go run ./applypatch -p=1 diff.patch
go mod tidy -diff
! stdout .
cmp go.mod go.mod.tidyResult
cmp go.sum go.sum.tidyResult


-- applypatch/main.go --
// Applies a unified diff, so that no host patch command decides whether
// the check around it runs.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

var strip = flag.Int("p", 1, "leading path components to drop from a file name")

func fail(format string, arg ...any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "applypatch: "+format+"\n", arg...)
	os.Exit(1)
}

// stripName drops the leading components -p asks for.
func stripName(name string) string {
	part := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(name), "/")
	if len(part) <= *strip {
		fail("name %q has no component left after -p=%d", name, *strip)
	}
	return filepath.Join(part[*strip:]...)
}

// lines splits src after each newline. The final line keeps the ending it
// has, so a file that ends without one round-trips.
func lines(src []byte) []string {
	var out []string
	for len(src) > 0 {
		end := bytes.IndexByte(src, '\n')
		if end < 0 {
			out = append(out, string(src))
			break
		}
		out = append(out, string(src[:end+1]))
		src = src[end+1:]
	}
	return out
}

func atoi(text string) int {
	num, err := strconv.Atoi(text)
	if err != nil {
		fail("bad number %q", text)
	}
	return num
}

// hunkHead reads the source start and the source count from a hunk header.
func hunkHead(line string) (start, count int) {
	body := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "@@ -")
	end := strings.IndexByte(body, ' ')
	if end < 0 {
		fail("bad hunk header %q", line)
	}
	span := body[:end]
	count = 1
	if comma := strings.IndexByte(span, ','); comma >= 0 {
		count = atoi(span[comma+1:])
		span = span[:comma]
	}
	return atoi(span), count
}

func main() {
	flag.Parse()
	if flag.NArg() != 1 {
		fail("usage: applypatch [-p=N] patchfile")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(flag.Arg(0))
	if err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	patch := lines(raw)

	for idx := 0; idx < len(patch); {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(patch[idx], "--- ") {
			idx++
			continue
		}
		if idx+1 >= len(patch) || !strings.HasPrefix(patch[idx+1], "+++ ") {
			fail("a --- line carries no +++ line")
		}
		name := stripName(strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimPrefix(patch[idx+1], "+++ "), "\r\n"))
		idx += 2

		src, err := os.ReadFile(name)
		if err != nil {
			fail("%v", err)
		}
		have := lines(src)
		var out []string
		pos := 0

		for idx < len(patch) && strings.HasPrefix(patch[idx], "@@ -") {
			start, left := hunkHead(patch[idx])
			idx++
			for pos < start-1 {
				if pos >= len(have) {
					fail("%s: a hunk starts past the end of the file", name)
				}
				out = append(out, have[pos])
				pos++
			}
			for idx < len(patch) {
				line := patch[idx]
				if line == "" || line == "\n" {
					break
				}
				if left == 0 && line[0] != '+' && line[0] != '\\' {
					break
				}
				switch line[0] {
				case ' ', '-':
					if pos >= len(have) || have[pos] != line[1:] {
						fail("%s: line %d does not match the patch", name, pos+1)
					}
					if line[0] == ' ' {
						out = append(out, have[pos])
					}
					pos++
					left--
				case '+':
					out = append(out, line[1:])
				case '\\':
					// The line above it carries no ending of its own.
					if len(out) > 0 {
						out[len(out)-1] = strings.TrimRight(out[len(out)-1], "\r\n")
					}
				default:
					fail("%s: unexpected patch line %q", name, line)
				}
				idx++
			}
			if left != 0 {
				fail("%s: a hunk ended with %d source lines unread", name, left)
			}
		}
		out = append(out, have[pos:]...)
		if err := os.WriteFile(name, []byte(strings.Join(out, "")), 0666); err != nil {
			fail("%v", err)
		}
		fmt.Println("patched", name)
	}
}

-- main.go --
package main

import "rsc.io/quote"

func main() {
	println(quote.Hello())
}
